name: LaserPecker LP2
tagline: Classic handheld LaserPecker LP2: portable diode engraver
tldr: LaserPecker LP2 Classic is the earlier portable LP line before LP2 Plus: app-driven, small work area, ideal for tags and phone-case scale jobs, not workshop production.
mainObjective: Portable LaserPecker engraving away from a full frame

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: 5W on LaserPecker LP2: engraving-first: photo fills and leather at moderate speeds
Open-frame: plan laser glasses, exhaust, and workspace rules from day one
Work area ~100 × 100 mm (verify): confirm your typical job sizes fit the bed
cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone
Confirm optical wattage on the listing before you buy
beginnerNotes: This profile covers LaserPecker LP2. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Run scrap tests first. Use this profile’s reference times for quotes, not marketing claims.

editorialDepth.advantages: LaserPecker LP2 5W suits makers who sell marks, photos, and gifts more than daily panel cutting. Reasonable open-frame entry price.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip if you already quote 4 mm+ cutting in production. Not for cast acrylic or bare metal without spray.
